newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to lower margins on coffee futures June 18.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to lower margins on coffee futures June 18.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Tuesday it will lower the margin on the July "C" coffee contract by $2,000 to $10,000, including a $4,000 spot charge, effective June 18.
The margin on September "C" coffee futures will also be decreased by $2,000 to $8,000, including a $2,000 spot charge.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will be lowered by $2,000 to $6,000, the exchange said in a statement.
The decrease in margins comes about two weeks after the exchange last raised margins on coffee futures.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
